text:
rachael: Heads-up: new high-severity libssl vuln discovered in our ubuntu-base image. We need a coordinated rebuild + signer key cutover. Proposing maintenance Sun 2026-04-11 04:00-06:00 UTC.

tom: I can take CI changes. Plan: add dual-key support so verifiers accept old and new key URIs for a short window. Also auto-publish SBOM (cycloneDX) to artifacts.

veer: I'll own KMS rotation and audit export. Need to confirm target sink bucket and retention. Prefer a dedicated log-sink SA rather than broad viewer perms.

alejandra: IAM lead here. I'll tighten signer SA bindings to just the CI project and add a time-limited binding for the rotation window. Also reduce token lifetime for the signer SA.

signing-bot: scan: ubuntu-base:1.14 -> libssl CVE-2026-1234 (medium). Ticket SEC-2026-334 created.

rachael: Rollout sketch: build+sign staging at 04:00, 20m staging canary, then 04:30 prod canary at 5% for 45m, full roll at 05:15. Rollback plan must be tested.

tom: pipeline patch will include: `--kms-dryrun` flag, cosign sign step, dual-verify matrix, and artifact metadata (sbom + cosign.prov). I'll open MR today.

veer: Preflight checklist I'll run: KMS sink write test, cosign verify old+new URIs, simulate anomalous signer usage alert. I'll add alerts to paging for unexpected signer calls.

alejandra: IAM PR will include terraform diff, conditional binding for `env=ci`, and a short rationale for least-privilege. I'll also recommend workload identity for runners.

signing-bot: compliance note: key rotation touching production requires 48h notice. Tag SEC-2026-334 with `compliance:notice`.

rachael: Owners confirmed: tom (CI), veer (KMS & audit), alejandra (IAM), rachael (coord + SEC ticket). Post any MR/PR links here. If monitoring shows signature failures or >1% image pull errors during canary, pause and rollback.

tom: pushing draft MR -> gitlab.com/redwood/infra/ci with dual-key verify and SBOM artifact. Link shortly.

rachael: thanks. I'll post the formal maintenance notice once PR/MR are up. Ping here if blocked. :thumbsup:
